sentences.text:
on 18 November, 2023
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.11380 Of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is filed by the petitioners/A1 to A10 to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.207 of 2023 of Thirumalayapalem Police Station, Khammam, registered for the offences under Sections 498A,
294B and 506 r/w 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that a false complaint has been filed implicating all the petitioners.

4. Since the subject complaint is outcome of differences between wife and husband and in-laws and the punishment prescribed for the offences alleged against the petitioners/A1 to A10 are up to seven years, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the criminal petition with a direction to the investigating officer in Crime No.207 of 2023 of Thirumalayapalem Police Station, Khammam, to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41A Cr.P.C., and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously and conclude investigation.

5. With the above direction, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
